outcome_level.window: filing availability T through T+12 months

primary_endpoint.name: hard_distress_12m
primary_endpoint.positive: bankruptcy filing, court-supervised restructuring, explicit going-concern opinion/substantial-doubt disclosure, or publicly documented material covenant default within the outcome window
primary_endpoint.negative: none of the frozen primary events found after dual review of allowed sources

secondary_endpoint.name: financial_deterioration_12m
secondary_endpoint.positive: at least two of: revenue decline >=10%; transition from positive net income to net loss; operating cash flow decline >=25% or turns negative; free cash flow negative in both subsequent reported periods; debt-to-assets increases >=10 percentage points
secondary_endpoint.negative: fewer than two frozen deterioration conditions
secondary_endpoint.independence: calculated from forward public facts only; FinRisk scores, rules and predictions are prohibited inputs

prohibited: future restatement outside the outcome window
